'''R4-X2''' was a green [[R4 astromech droid|R4]] [[astromech droid]] operating during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. It served on board the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|main cruiser]] of the [[Resistance]].<ref name="DroidFactory" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R4-X2 was created for the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The droid was revealed beforehand in a [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] two-pack of figures tied into the film and released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] at ''Star Wars'' [[Celebration Orlando]] in [[April]], 2017.<ref name="DroidFactory" />
